channel.title: The Vicksburg Post - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Vicksburg Post (vicksburgpost.com)

item.title: Hinds, VWSD launch first-of-its-kind trades program
item.description: Hinds Community College and Vicksburg Warren schools are launching Mississippi’s first free skilled trades program, letting seniors earn college career certificates at no cost.

item.title: Baseball roundup: Warren Central bests Vicksburg; St. Al tops Manchester
item.description: Warren Central notched its 18th consecutive win over crosstown rival Vicksburg High, and St. Aloysius beat Manchester Academy in Wednesday's high school baseball action in Warren County.

item.title: TEACHER OF THE YEAR: Jackson teaches a love of music
item.description: Sherman Avenue Elementary music teacher Jermaine L. Jackson, a 12-year educator and Educator of the Year nominee, hooks students with dance, song and instruments built around music they already love.

item.title: Police investigate fatal shooting on Highway 61 South
item.description: Jaylon Walker, 25, was pronounced dead at the scene of a shooting Wednesday on Highway 61 South.

item.title: Beads, floats and gumbo take over downtown Saturday
item.description: Two of Vicksburg’s most anticipated events — the Mardi Gras Parade and the Carnaval de Mardi Gras and Gumbo Cook-Off — return with family-friendly fun, food and festivities.

item.title: Hunters' Hall of Fame: Evan Rowland
item.description: The Vicksburg Post invites its readers to submit their hunting photos. Please email them to sports@vicksburgpost.com or submit them online at vicksburgpost.com under the Hunters’ Hall of Fame tab.

item.title: Who's Hot: Nick Carson
item.description: Nick Carson led Vicksburg High's baseball team to a lopsided win over Raymond in the season opener on Monday.

item.title: Slow start dooms Gators in Region 2-5A semifinals
item.description: Vicksburg High's boys basketball team fell behind early and couldn't catch up in a loss to Holmes County Central in the MHSAA Region 2-5A tournament semifinals on Thursday.

item.title: PCA pummels Raymond to break into win column
item.description: Coltin Hancock had big game hitting and pitching to lead Porter's Chapel Academy's baseball team to its first win of the season. Meanwhile, Port Gibson rode a big sixth-inning rally to a victory over Vicksburg High.

item.title: Ridgeland holds off Warren Central in Region 2-6A tournament
item.description: Warren Central put up a good fight, but couldn't get past Ridgeland in the semifinals of the MHSAA Region 2-6A boys basketball tournament on Thursday.
